name: Yes, I'm alone.
source:
The protagonist has been distrustful of the news and of their neighbor, making sure no one enters their house. And for the past few days, they’ve noticed someone lurking around their home…

Would it be possible to survive with the pale visitor? 

[Edited from [url=https://mourners.itch.io/yes-im-alone]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角向来对新闻报道与隔壁邻居心存戒备，严防死守不让任何人踏入自家大门。然而最近几天，他察觉到似乎有人正在自家屋子周围暗中徘徊……

与那位苍白的访客共处一室，真的还有一线生机吗？

[摘自[url=https://mourners.itch.io/yes-im-alone]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
